title: Secondary Peak Analysis V1
description: Detailed characterization of a single identified spectral peak: bandwidth, decay, two independent Q estimates, and analysis confidence, with raw-WAV provenance. Characterizes a measured peak only; it assigns no wood quality, tone quality, historical equivalence, or suitability. Optional metrics are absent (not sentinel values) when unresolved; their names are listed in blocked_fields. A NOT_RESOLVED secondary result never invalidates the primary frequency observation.

source_wav_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the original WAV bytes this analysis derives from

peak_id.description: Identifier of the selected peak (e.g. p1, A0) as named by primary extraction

peak_frequency_hz.description: Frequency of the selected peak (Hz); chosen by primary extraction, not re-selected here

status.description: RESOLVED: bandwidth and decay both resolved; PARTIAL: exactly one; NOT_RESOLVED: neither (primary peak still valid)

peak_magnitude_db.description: Peak magnitude in dB relative to the spectrum maximum (<= 0)

bandwidth_3db_hz.description: Resolved -3 dB (half-power) bandwidth (Hz); absent when crossings are unresolved

q_from_bandwidth.description: Q = f0 / (f2 - f1) from the half-power bandwidth; independent of q_from_decay

decay_tau_s.description: Amplitude decay time constant tau = 1/alpha (s) from the exponential envelope fit

q_from_decay.description: Q = 1/(2*zeta) from the exponential envelope fit; independent of q_from_bandwidth

log_decrement.description: Logarithmic decrement delta from successive envelope peaks; cross-check diagnostic only

q_agreement_pct.description: Agreement between q_from_bandwidth and q_from_decay (100 = identical); present only when both exist

confidence.description: Analysis-confidence scalar (not scientific truth); mean of confidence_components

confidence_components.description: Component scores used to construct confidence, retained so the scalar is not opaque

fit_window_s.description: Duration of the envelope segment used for the decay fit (s)

noise_floor_db.description: Estimated noise floor in dB relative to the spectrum maximum

method_flags.description: Which methods contributed (e.g. bandwidth_halfpower, decay_curvefit, logdec_cross_check)

blocked_fields.description: Names of fields that could not be resolved and are therefore absent
